summary.text: Angel Sanchez is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Ismael Luna. A Milwaukee business owner, he has run unsuccessfully for several offices since 2016.

paragraphs.text: Angel Sanchez was born on July 25, 1969, in Burlington, Wisconsin, attended South Division High School in Milwaukee and received a bachelor's degree in communications from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee in 1996.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes starting Sanchez Construction Inc., working as a substitute teacher and founding the city's graffiti removal program.
Sanchez lost the 2016 Milwaukee Common Council District 12 election to incumbent Jose G. Perez.
He was the Republican nominee for Wisconsin State Assembly District 8 in 2018, losing to incumbent JoCasta Zamarripa, and again in 2020, losing to Sylvia Ortiz-Velez.

In 2022 he lost the general election for Wisconsin State Senate District 3 to incumbent Tim Carpenter, and on May 2, 2023, he lost the special election for Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors District 14 to Caroline Gomez-Tom.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Assembly District 8 on August 11, 2026.
